# ASEAN Club Championship Preview: Borneo F.C. Samarinda VS Manila Digger FC - prediction, team news, lineup

﻿

Posted Tuesday, November 17, 2026 by 7M Sport [...] [(Manila Digger FC) Strength]:   
1. Manila Digger FC are currently 6 wins from 6 in the Philippines Football League, leading with 18 points, scoring a large number of goals without a draw or loss. The team's winning habit, belief, and competitive rhythm are at their seasonal peak, and they come away with an 'invincible' mindset. [...] Manila Digger FC have won all six matches in their domestic league and are formidable away, scoring 14 goals and conceding only 1 in their last 5 away matches while winning all of them, with explosive attacking and defensive performances, but traveling far away carries risks of adapting to the venue and climate.   
  
The two teams have no previous head-to-head record, and Borneo F.C. Samarinda have home advantage, so overall Borneo F.C. Samarinda are favored to win.
